from pathlib import Path
programs=base/'programs'
programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 1)}
    marker = next(iter(colors))
    pts = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == marker]
    r0, c0 = min(r for r, c in pts), min(c for r, c in pts)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in pts]
    sh, sw = max(r for r, c in shape)+1, max(c for r, c in shape)+1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-sh+1):
        for c in range(w-sw+1):
            cells = [(r+dr, c+dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if all(grid[rr][cc] in (0, marker) for rr, cc in cells):
                for rr, cc in cells:
                    if out[rr][cc] == 0:
                        out[rr][cc] = marker
    return out
'''
